name: Paladin Sun Dervish
body:
Agile and graceful, these paladins evoke the fury of the sun, banishing evil as they twist and turn, blade in hand.

Skills

A sun dervish adds Acrobatics (Dex) and Perform (Cha) to his list of class skills, instead of Handle Animal (Cha).

This alters skills.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Sun dervishes are not proficient with medium armor, heavy armor or shields (except bucklers).

This alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Dervish Dancer (Ex)

A sun dervish gains Dervish Dance as a bonus feat. He counts as having the Weapon Finesse feat for the purpose of fulfilling prerequisites.

Battle Dance (Ex)

At 3rd level, a sun dervish gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC while wearing light armor or no armor. Anything that causes the sun dervish to lose his Dexterity bonus to AC also causes him to lose this dodge bonus. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 paladin levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of +5 at 19th level).

In addition, starting at 5th level, whenever a sun dervish is under the benefits of haste, the bonus on attack rolls and the dodge bonus on AC and Reflex saves gained from haste are increased by 1. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 paladin levels beyond 5th (to a maximum of +5 at 19th level, including the base bonus).

This ability replaces divine bond.

Dancing Storm (Ex)

At 11th level, a sun dervish can take a full-attack action and still move up to his speed. He can make his attacks at any point during his movement, but must move at least 5 feet between each attack. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.

This ability replaces aura of justice.

Dance of a Thousand Cuts (Sp)

At 14th level, a sun dervish may spend one use of his smite evil ability to cast dance of a thousand cuts as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to his paladin level.

This ability replaces aura of faith.
